notes.text: The phrase **walked with** is used here as a common expression that means “lived in a close relationship with.” Consider whether or not you have a similar expression in your language. or [Enoch lived in a faithful relationship with God]
If you include the meaning of Noah’s name in your translation or in a footnote, make sure it matches what Lamech says about him in the following quote so that it is clear why he was given that name.

Here, **a son of 500 years** is a common expression that means “was 500 years old.” If this phrase does not have that meaning in your language, you could use a comparable expression from your language that does have that meaning or state the meaning plainly. or [Noah turned 500 years old]
